provider.description: pi provider id (anthropic, openai, google, ollama, openrouter, …)

model.description: exact pi model id within that provider

personaModelsMap.description: persona name → {provider, model}. Names must match the Forge persona catalogue read from forge-cli's bundled vendored plugin (forge-cli/forge/personas/*.md). A reserved 'default' key applies to any persona without an entry.

pipelines.description: Per-pipeline overrides. Pipeline names match the Forge plugin's pipeline catalogue.

phases.description: Per-phase overrides keyed by role (e.g. 'implement', 'commit'). Roles must match the plugin's pipeline definition.

model-override.description: L4 — atomic per-phase override. Either a persona-models key by name (string) or an inline {provider, model}.
